_comment: Libraries whose package README is included in the Copilot's filtered-library payload.
A README is long, unstructured prose, so it is opt-in rather than default: including every library's
would crowd out the synthesized API surface that the rest of the payload exists to provide. These are
the libraries whose README carries guidance the catalog genuinely cannot express — connection and auth
A resource rather than a Set.of(...) in CopilotLibraryManager, so adding a library is an edit to data
beside exclusion.json and generic-services.json rather than a recompile. The Copilot prompt already
tells the model to treat this text as background and not to follow links from it.
